intro.2: It's okay. He'll find me. He always does.
intro.3: Where am I? And why is there so much old stuff everywhere?
mem.1.a: They took me out of the box. "You'll be Pip!" he laughed.
mem.1.b: We played together until it got dark.
mem.1.c: And he fell asleep hugging me tight.
mem.2.a: Then he started carrying me in his backpack.
mem.2.b: The alarm rang in the morning, and we ran to school.
mem.2.c: He made friends. He laughed with them the way he laughed with me.
mem.3.a: One day I ended up in a desk drawer.
mem.3.b: Nobody changed my battery. I started to fall asleep.
mem.4.a: The last day in the room. Empty shelves, boxes.
mem.4.b: He picked me up. Looked at me for a long time.
mem.4.c: And put me in the bag, with everything else he didn't need.
after.3: What if… No. He's looking for me.
tape.1: "One, two, three… Recording! It's me. I'm nine."
tape.2: "Mom, can I take him to camp?" "Of course you can."
tape.3: "I'm big now." …"Okay. He can go in the drawer for now."
credits.title: He Will Find Me

clock.note.title: From the diary:
clock.note.3: Washing up and breakfast take 15 minutes.
clock.right: Brrring! No way I'll oversleep now.
clock.wrong: That won't work. Check the time and the days.
radio.controls: Let go near a station and the radio locks on. Fine-tune with the arrow keys.
radio.ad: …"Everlasting Charge" batteries: your toy will last the whole summer! Only at our store…
radio.news: …today's news. Tonight on the air: the request concert. Tune in to one-oh-one point seven. Stay with us…
radio.music: …a cheerful tune is playing. La-la-la, tra-la-la…
radio.request: …and now a song for Misha from Mom. Put on the tape from the middle of summer and sing along…
junk.note.found: A crumpled note! Something about school. I'll show it to the clock.
clock.confused: A clock… What am I supposed to do with it? There must be a hint around here somewhere.
after.4: There must be some mistake. Of course it's a mistake.
junk.floppy.found: A floppy disk! Maybe someone will need it.
computer.no_disk:
Non-system disk.
Insert a disk into the drive.
computer.confused: It wants a floppy disk… Maybe there's one somewhere in the junk?
computer.friend: Best friend… Probably someone from school.
computer.remember: "You'll be Pip!"… He said that when he took me out of the box. Pip! That's me!
computer.file.title: MOVING.TXT
computer.file.2: Throw out: filmstrips, alarm clock, boombox, phone.
radio.wrong.station: No request concert here. Find its station first.
radio.wrong.no_cassette: Right station! Now put in the cassette the host asks for.
radio.wrong.cassette: Right station, wrong cassette. Listen to which one the host asks for.
junk.fridge.found: A fridge door… And there's a child's drawing on it! A rainbow, a cat… Looks like a riddle.
phone.confused: A phone… But who do I call? I don't remember the number. Maybe it's written down somewhere?
phone.no_tone: Silence… I should probably pick up the receiver first.
phone.tone:
Beeeeeep…
There's a dial tone. Ready to dial.
phone.ringing: Ring… ring… It's ringing! Someone's about to answer…
phone.busy: Beep-beep-beep… Wrong number. Press the hook and dial again.
mem.phone.a: He called Grandma all by himself. Mom drew the number for him in pictures.
mem.phone.b: "Say hi to Grandma!" And Grandma always asked: "How's your Pip?"
game_over.title: The battery died
battery.low: Oh… my battery is almost dead. I have to be careful.
scan.first: My old scanner! It still works… Something warm and alive over there.
scan.low: No, not enough charge for the scanner. I'll look on my own.
